name: ip232-serial
description: Connect the BBC serial port (RS423) to a tcpser-style IP232 server over TCP

parameters.label: Server URL
parameters.description: IP232 server endpoint as [scheme://]host:port (e.g. url="ip232://bbs.example.com:25232"); alternative to host/port, cannot be combined with them

parameters.label: Server host
parameters.description: IP232 server hostname or address (default localhost; alternative to url)

parameters.label: Server port
parameters.description: IP232 server TCP port (default 25232; alternative to url)

parameters.label: Mode
parameters.description: 'ip232' (0xFF-escaped, persistent connection) or 'raw' (pure byte pipe, connect/disconnect on RTS)

parameters.label: Convey RTS
parameters.description: convey the BBC's RTS line to the server via the 0xFF escape (ip232 mode only)

parameters.label: Transmit buffer (bytes)
parameters.description: transmit buffer size in bytes; the BBC's /CTS asserts at/above it
